mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 30 days compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods with FEDFUNDS decline >0.25pp over 30 days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) coincides with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), the combination signals persistent inflationary pressures requiring aggressive monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM AND CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%
regime_hint: high labor demand and high inflation regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when both triggers are met, or the interaction term is insignificant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion marked by quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% (GDPC1 QoQ) and unemployment below 4.0% (UNRATE), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and anticipation of monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 QoQ > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the regime-specific effect is insignificant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate recessionary risks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.3 million units and consumer credit (RSAFS) grows at over 5% YoY, the combination signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both triggers are met, or the interaction term is insignificant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market with unemployment below 4.0% (UNRATE) and strong payroll growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.4% MoM), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings momentum and low recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.4% MoM, or the regime-specific effect is insignificant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
